prompt: Stage 4-5, level 8, 51 HP. You just completed an Infinity Edge. Your board: Malphite and Sett frontline, Ahri (AP, two items) in the backline, Aphelios (2-star, Guinsoo's Rageblade) and Sivir (1-star, no items, played for Hunter). Who holds the Infinity Edge?
explanation:
Infinity Edge is an attack-damage crit item, and the question is which unit converts crit into the most damage over the rest of the game. Aphelios is 2-star, already has an attack-speed item that multiplies every crit, and is the unit your comp is built to protect. Sivir is 1-star and on the board for a trait; giving her the item asks you to itemise a unit you will not 2-star, and splits your damage across two AD carries when the board only has one frontline to hold for both. Ahri is an AP caster with two AP items; Infinity Edge on her wastes the attack-damage half of the item.

If Sivir 2-stars naturally she becomes a fine second holder for later AD items, but the first completed AD item follows the rule: the itemised, 2-star, protected carry gets the multiplier.
principle: Damage multipliers stack on the one carry you are protecting; splitting items across two AD units halves both.
commonMistake: Spreading items "so the board has two threats" before the first threat is fully built.
